title: G45 Implementation Eligibility Analysis
methodology: Binary analysis + live game testing + public reference comparison

NESYS_card_event.reason: Requires NESYS certificate trust (cert3.nesys.jp). Cannot implement without compromising game binary or connecting to real NESYS infrastructure.
NESYS_card_event.safety_constraint: Cannot create fake NESYS certificates, cannot proxy cert3.nesys.jp, cannot patch executable

NESYS_pipe.reason: NESYS pipe is a named pipe server (NesysService.exe). Game connects as client. Emulating the pipe requires implementing the binary protocol and certificate exchange.
NESYS_pipe.safety_constraint: Cannot implement NESYS pipe emulator, cannot start original NesysService, cannot bind port 1042

certificate_trust.reason: Game validates NESYS certificate against cert3.nesys.jp. Cannot generate valid certificates without the private key.
certificate_trust.safety_constraint: Cannot create fake NESYS certificates, cannot identify local profile as NESiCA

bNesicaReception_flag.reason: bNesicaReception is set by the game's internal NESYS handler after successful certificate authentication. Cannot be set without NESYS trust.
bNesicaReception_flag.safety_constraint: Cannot force bNesicaReception, cannot patch the seven-flag gate

bNesysServerLive_flag.reason: bNesysServerLive is set by the game's NESYS connection handler. Requires NESYS pipe connection and certificate exchange.
bNesysServerLive_flag.safety_constraint: Cannot force bNesysServerLive, cannot patch the seven-flag gate

player_profile_load.status: Handler implemented and tested. Game never calls this endpoint because NESYS card event never fires.

matching_server.status: Handler implemented and tested. Game accepts response and sets bWebServerLive=1.

local_card_event_eligibility.reason: Local Card event requires NESYS card reader hardware or NESYS pipe emulation. Neither is available within safety constraints.
local_card_event_eligibility.evidence: G44 live validation showed game loops at InsertStart → SystemDataCheck → PromotionMovie. No card event ever fires.
local_card_event_eligibility.possible_workaround: None within safety constraints. Would require NESYS pipe emulation or certificate trust.

safe_actions_remaining: Improve existing handler responses to match more game-expected fields
Add more player data fields to /player/profile/load response
Implement additional server endpoints that don't require NESYS trust
Improve test coverage for existing handlers
